misiones.desc: A random house and a random shot: FIXED (hold still at an exact point), ORBIT (circle the house along an arc) or REVEAL (rise while pulling away). It has to reach the start of the route and stick to the camera point, with its nose (the camera) on the house, at the right pace and without shaking. The house is an obstacle.
misiones.exito: Shot done = finish the route with an average image quality ≥ 50 % (framing × on the route × pace × steady).

misiones.desc: Same as Filming, but with 2.5 m/s wind and gusts: it has to compensate for the wind's push without leaving the route. Without this, at the farm the shot drifts off.
misiones.exito: Shot done = finish the route with an average quality ≥ 50 %, with the wind pushing.

misiones.desc: Same as Filming, with 5-9 poles or umbrellas 1.5 m from the route. It has to see them with the 10 distance sensors (give your drone the ToF sensors) and pass between them without losing the framing.
misiones.exito: Shot done = finish the route with an average quality ≥ 50 % without touching any pole.

misiones.desc: A random ring 3-8 m away, starting out facing any direction. It helps the AI learn to fly YOUR drone (heavier and slower than before) without forgetting the basics.
misiones.exito: Fly through the ring without crashing.

misiones.desc: A random ring with columns in the way. Reviewing it now and then with your drone keeps it from forgetting how to dodge while it learns to film.
misiones.exito: Fly through the ring without touching any column.

misiones.desc: A random house and ONE photo: a point 7-10.5 m from the front, or close and high looking at the roof (inspection). It has to arrive, BRAKE and hold still for 2.5-3.5 s with the subject centered. That's how the 📷 and 🔎 jobs on the phone work.
misiones.exito: Photo done = average quality ≥ 50 % while holding still at the point.

misiones.desc: Same as Photo, but 2-4 photos in a row around the house, in order: each one 40-90° past the previous one. After each photo it has to fly to the next one without hitting the house.
misiones.exito: Set done = ALL photos with quality ≥ 50 %.

misiones.para: The league and the freestyle rivals (🏁)
misiones.desc: A track of 6-9 gates in order, far apart (7-15 m) and with turns, on a 60 m field with columns on the sides. They must be passed FAST: the speed reward pays each leg's speed. It's what the freestyle rivals fly.
misiones.exito: Pass all gates in order (passing within 1 m of the center is enough).

misiones.desc: A far platform (14-32 m), sometimes on a rooftop, with buildings in the way and a bit of wind. Get there without crashing and hold STILL for 1 s above it: then the autopilot lands, as in the game.
misiones.exito: Stay 1 s in a row within 0.5 m of the point 0.6 m above the platform.

misiones.desc: The hare: a target that runs on its own over a 40 m field at 2-6 m/s, climbs, dives, changes pace and dodges columns. The drone knows where it is and how it moves: to catch it, it has to cut corners. In freestyle, you are the hare.
misiones.exito: Pass within 0.8 m of the hare.

premios.desc: For every second filmed, according to image quality (0 to 1): house centered in frame × stuck to the camera point × at its pace × no shaking. This is THE filming reward.
Nose (the camera) toward the house: pays right away for every degree it turns toward it and charges per second if it looks elsewhere. Without this it reaches the area facing any direction.
For every meter it gets closer to the camera point (first the start of the route, then the moving point).
When it finishes the route: this reward × the shot's average quality. A bad shot barely pays.
For every second of sharp roll/pitch turns. A shaky video is useless: raise it if you see the image shaking.
For changing the sticks abruptly. Careful: it also charges for the noise it explores with; set it too high and it stops trying things.
When it hits the house, the ground or leaves the area. In the game a crash costs money: make it hurt.
For passing within 1.2 m of something. It feels it BEFORE hitting the ceiling or the walls.
For heading toward an obstacle with less than 1 s until impact. It learns to brake in time.
For flying tilted. A little helps keep it from making exaggerated maneuvers.
A tiny bit every step: so it doesn't dawdle getting there.
When passing a ring, more reward if it got there fast. Useless for filming (set to 0).
Per second with the subject CENTERED in the frame (framing only, regardless of the route), while filming and in the last 3 m before the shot: it arrives at the photo already framed.
When the shot (or photo) starts: the stiller it arrives, the bigger the reward (stopped = all of it; at 2 m/s = nothing). A photo taken while braking comes out blurry.
Per second and per m/s it climbs or drops when the shot doesn't ask for it (filming or arriving at the shot). Different from shaking: this is bobbing up and down.
Per second of nose turns that start or stop abruptly. In the video it shows as a jolt.
Per second and per m/s above 3 m/s. Near a house or people you don't fly flat out.
Per second of throttle above what it needs to hover (sudden climbs, speeding up and braking). Saves battery on long sets.
